title: Rust egress decapsulation: IPv6-in-IPv6 outer at E with inner-dst verification
description: Child of b7z9.4 (spec 05-routing 8.9 R-05-063). No Rust runtime implements egress decapsulation: survey_routing_headers (rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs:259-394) has no next-header-41 case and errors InvalidSourceRoute. Add: on encountering next_header IPV6_IN_IPV6 (const from sibling bead) at the END of the outer SRH walk, parse the inner IPv6 header, verify inner dst == this node's authorized primary 02xx (E check), then return/propagate the inner packet for continued processing (coordinate with the caller's contract in rpl_stack). Fail-closed on malformed inner header. Unit tests: valid decap, inner-dst mismatch rejected, malformed inner rejected. Files: rust/lichen-node/src/rpl_stack/util.rs + ingress caller. After: lichen-core IPV6_IN_IPV6 const.
